1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

250929|4b2429f8.name: Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct
250929|4b2429f8.text: <As you approach the enormous cyclone construct, you hear a faint buzzing emanating from beneath its massive armor plates. If you listen carefully, you think you might be able to hear a few words being formed but they are too distorted to make out.>

252359|80b579b6.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|80b579b6.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

252383|28d94b03.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|28d94b03.text:
I suppose that is true. I and the rest of my elites used to belong to an order known as the Empyrean Blades. We were the personal guard of our former leader, the Shal'nan. 

In the current, uncertain times we do what we can to help lead the peacekeepers' citizen militia, since we are the closest thing to professional soldiers left on Zephras.

252383|5676c909.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|5676c909.text:
<Valennia looks away briefly before looking hesitantly back in your direction.>

The Shal'nan was the very best of us. It was he who stood up for our people against madness and oppression in Eldre'Thalas nearly ten thousand years ago. It was the Shal'nan who led us across the uncharted sea to escape the murderous vengeance of our ancient enemies.

It was the Shal'nan who brokered the pact of friendship with the wind spirits that allowed us to ascend to Skywall... and survive.

He was ever the servant leader to his people, even after he abdicated his position of power and retired.

252383|8d2a94b9.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|8d2a94b9.text:
If I knew that then I suspect that life here on Zephras would be much, much easier. So many of our struggles and conflicts revolve around that very mystery.

I appreciate your curiosity on this matter but I'm afraid that is all I have to say about this for today.

252383|f5d2c665.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|f5d2c665.text:
I might be the only living shen'dorei left amongst our people who had more than a handful of words with him.

I served him as the captain of his Empyrean Blades for nearly nine centuries, right up until... he left us.

Even still, I can't rightly claim that I "knew" him. He was ever a reserved and solitary man. He spent most of his time alone or in communion with the spirits in the spires high above the Shrine of the Four Winds... the place that the cult now calls the 'Shrine of Akir'.

252389|2becf397.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
252389|2becf397.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a $c, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

252448|14de7cf6.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|14de7cf6.text: It's always great to see you, $N.

252448|1e1e1370.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|1e1e1370.text:
Hmm, what an odd question? Not much, I suppose. My mother used to use it as a powder for babies to prevent diaper rash, but past that, I don't know of any other good use for it.

Why do you ask?

252448|aadf0ebc.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|aadf0ebc.text: <The man lying before you shifts uncomfortably. He's recovering from some very nasty wounds.>

252475|8b2299ed.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|8b2299ed.text: Greetings, I am Elaadrin Evengale, the current Supreme Magister of the High Order. How can I help you?

252800|d3392a1d.name: Aamelia Windfield
252800|d3392a1d.text: The Windfield Orchard has seen better days...

253004|a3b7de8e.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|a3b7de8e.text: Another Alchemist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

253474|37e215b2.name: Peacekeeper
253474|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

253474|4d63cc9b.name: Peacekeeper
253474|4d63cc9b.text: You'll want to head over to the Hall of Arms on the north side of Valanaar.

253474|7fc1d917.name: Peacekeeper
253474|7fc1d917.text: May I help you locate something, citizen?

254345|bb901712.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

254411|0e051c59.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
254411|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

256514|4f344806.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|4f344806.text: Anyway, I should probably get back to work. Speaking of, do you have any food or valuables that I could lift off of you? Maybe some windstones? Could always use more windstones?

256514|5198072d.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|5198072d.text: Look around you. There's so much beauty here. The wind on your face, the blue skies overhead. It's so bright and alive, but yes, it's also quite dark. It feels like a prison. A prison where the guards have all left the prisoners in their cells to fend for themselves.

256514|6387fa8c.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|6387fa8c.text: Just thinking. It's scary out here these days, you know? Any minute this section of the island could drop out from under me and I'd go tumbling... somewhere? Tell me, do you even know what happens to $r who fall off the island?

256514|64ae14a6.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|64ae14a6.text: <A solitary bandit sits on the edge of the precipice, clearly deep in thought. If he notices you, he doesn't seem interested in attacking you.>

256514|8851d200.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|8851d200.text: You don't look like much, but something tells me you are right. I think I'll just sit here a bit longer. Thanks for the chat, stranger.

256514|bde78361.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|bde78361.text:
No one does. Because the only people who've done it have never come back. When the skycutters used to run between Valanaar and New Eldranaar or Shen'dramar, sometimes an accident or other misfortune would cause someone to go overboard. When it happened, they wouldn't even slow the ship down. No point.

For all we know, anyone who fell off is still out there... tumbling endlessly forever.

257006|8cd6b7fd.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257008|d62b45b0.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

92727-complete.name: Unknown
92727-complete.text: <The satchel lying before you has a few specks of what appears to be dried blood on the flap. Studying the stain, you notice that the flap also has a name embroidered onto it. It reads "Fillion Flamebreeze".>
92727-complete.title: The Missing Scholar

92840-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92840-accept.text:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840-accept.title: Catching Wind

92849-accept.name: Unknown
92849-accept.text: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>
92849-accept.title: The Missing Scholar

94013-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-accept.text:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the $c.
94013-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94013-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-complete.text:
Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.

Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the $c that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
94013-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94978-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-accept.text:
Every $c begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras. 

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
94978-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94978-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-complete.text: Well tamed, $N! You are becoming adept already.
94978-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94979-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94979-accept.text:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged $c that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979-accept.title: Taming the Beast
